description: Milestone 1 implementation for a local insurance policy analysis application: validate, ingest, segment, trace, and transactionally persist policy PDFs before semantic retrieval and LLM assessment are added in Milestone 2.

questions.question: Which language should the Streamlit frontend use?

options.label: Python
options.description: Recommended because Streamlit applications are written in Python.

questions.rationale: Streamlit is Python-native and matches the requested Python 3.13 runtime.

questions.question: Which presentation framework should implement the web interface?

options.label: Streamlit
options.description: Python data application framework for upload, review, and status workflows.

questions.question: Which Milestone 1 user workflows are required in the interface?

options.label: PDF upload
options.description: Upload policy PDFs and initiate ingestion.

options.label: Validation status
options.description: Display validation, processing, and persisted-result status.

options.label: Document and version review
options.description: Review policy metadata, document records, and policy versions.

options.label: Clause traceability review
options.description: View extracted clauses and their source-page references.

options.label: Audit-friendly error handling
options.description: Display actionable validation and ingestion errors without stack traces.

questions.rationale: These workflows expose the Milestone 1 ingestion boundary and persisted traceability.

questions.question: Which language should the FastAPI service use?

options.label: Python
options.description: Recommended for the requested Python 3.13 FastAPI stack.

questions.question: Which API framework should implement policy ingestion and persistence?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: Typed asynchronous API framework for upload and document endpoints.

questions.question: Which Milestone 1 backend capabilities are required?

options.label: PDF validation
options.description: Validate MIME/content, extension, size, and structural PDF integrity.

options.label: SHA-256 deduplication fingerprint
options.description: Hash uploaded bytes before persistence and use it for duplicate detection.

options.label: Transactional metadata and document persistence
options.description: Persist policy metadata and source document records atomically with versions and clauses.

options.label: Policy version persistence
options.description: Store policy effective periods and document version relationships.

options.label: Clause segmentation
options.description: Create bounded clause records from extracted policy text.

options.label: Page traceability
options.description: Record source page and character offsets for clauses and extracted text.

options.label: PyMuPDF extraction
options.description: Use PyMuPDF for PDF parsing and page text extraction.

options.label: Pydantic v2 schemas
options.description: Use Pydantic v2 request and response models.

options.label: SQLAlchemy 2.x persistence
options.description: Use SQLAlchemy 2.x declarative models and sessions.

options.label: Health and ingestion API
options.description: Expose operational health and deterministic ingestion endpoints.

questions.rationale: These capabilities form the complete Milestone 1 ingestion responsibility.

questions.question: Which data stores are required?

options.label: SQLite
options.description: Local embedded relational database for policy documents, versions, clauses, and source references.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only if no application data is persisted.

questions.rationale: SQLite was explicitly requested and supplies Milestone 1 persistence.

questions.question: Does the application API require users to sign in?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must authenticate to use application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: The MVP runs locally and does not require application sign-in.

questions.rationale: No authentication requirement was provided; Docker Compose MVP is local and non-production.

questions.question: Which capabilities belong to Milestone 1 versus later work?

options.label: Structured PDF ingestion only
options.description: Milestone 1 stops at validated, traceable clause persistence.

questions.rationale: Semantic retrieval and LLM assessment are explicitly deferred to Milestone 2.

questions.question: Where should the ClaimLens implementation be organized?
questions.recommendedChoice: Use the repository structure requested by the user

options.label: Use the repository structure requested by the user
options.description: Follow any repository layout supplied separately by the user; no Azure layout is introduced.

questions.rationale: No explicit directory tree was included in the prompt. The plan records a repository layout and flags it as a clarification for confirmation.

questions.question: Which runtime orchestration should be documented for the MVP?

options.label: Docker Compose
options.description: Run FastAPI, Streamlit, and Ollama locally without Azure services.

questions.rationale: Docker Compose and local Ollama were explicitly requested.

clarifications.decision: Use a conventional monorepository layout: backend/, frontend/, tests/, data/, ollama/, and compose.yaml, unless the user supplies an overriding repository tree.
clarifications.impact: Final scaffold directory creation; behavior and dependencies remain unchanged.

clarifications.decision: Define schema fields after reviewing policy examples: carrier, policy number, policy holder, product, jurisdiction, effective date, expiry date, version label, and optional external source.
clarifications.impact: Add Alembic-free startup migration or SQLAlchemy metadata bootstrap for Milestone 1.

clarifications.decision: Start with deterministic heading/blank-line/numbered-list segmentation; preserve source offsets and page numbers. Exact semantic boundaries are deferred.
clarifications.impact: Implement and test deterministic segmentation with fixtures.

clarifications.decision: Use an initial 25 MB per-file limit, 100 pages, and explicit configuration overrides via environment variables.
clarifications.impact: File validation behavior and Docker environment defaults.
